description: Submission of the Orders issued under the Colombo Port City Economic Commission Act, to Parliament
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-08-31 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval has been granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2026-03-30 to designate 68 business entities belonging to the sectors of Information Technology, Consultancy Services, Business Process Outsourcing, Logistics, Infrastructure, Hybrid/Combined Business Models and General Enterprises as Secondary Businesses of Strategic Importance under the provisions of the Colombo Port City Economic Commission Act No.11 of 2021. Accordingly, Orders have been published through the Gazette Extraordinary Notifications dated 2026-04-10 designating those 68 businesses as Secondary Businesses of Strategic Importance. The proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development to submit the said Orders to Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.
